hooks.name: kube-node-viewer: session context
hooks.description: Branch, uncommitted files, skills and open spec tasks (scripts/agent-hooks/session-context.sh).

hooks.name: kube-node-viewer: guard destructive git
hooks.description: Blocks git commands that rewrite or delete published state or wipe local work (scripts/agent-hooks/guard-destructive.sh).

hooks.name: kube-node-viewer: commit guard
hooks.description: Blocks commits with export files (cluster data) or with lines added to a released CHANGELOG section (scripts/agent-hooks/commit-guard.sh).

hooks.name: kube-node-viewer: pre-commit checklist
hooks.description: On git commit, reminds the checklist in AGENTS.md (scripts/agent-hooks/commit-reminder.sh).
